description: EA-08 review (11e 23.02 MOVEMENT: 'Each time a unit makes any type of move, its models can be moved through AIRCRAFT models'). Setup privilege only: the Ork player's Wazbom Blastajet (the fixture's real AIRCRAFT VEHICLE datasheet, 120 mm base) has arrived and stands next to the Custodes Shield-Captain (40 mm, M 6"), engaging it; the board around them is open. Everything after that is a REAL click / drag: (1) a click selects the Shield-Captain; (2) a click on Fall Back begins an Ordered Retreat; (3) a drag 5.9" east along the Wazbom's side, whose straight path clips the Wazbom's base (the engine's own sweep says so), is STAGED — before the fix the Ordered Retreat crossing check (and the MONSTER/VEHICLE check) counted the AIRCRAFT model as a blocker and refused it; (4) End This Unit's Move: the Shield-Captain ends unengaged.

steps.comment: setup privilege: the Wazbom Blastajet (AIRCRAFT) is on the battlefield right next to the Shield-Captain (10 px between the bases: engaged); open ground around them (no terrain feature within reach in the layout this fixture loads)
steps.script:
var s = GameState.state
var wz = s.units.U_WAZBOM_BLASTAJET
wz.status = 2
wz.models[0].position = {"x": 1420.0, "y": 300.0}
s.units.U_SHIELD_CAPTAIN_A.models[0].position = {"x": 1356.0, "y": 420.0}
tree.current_scene._recreate_unit_visuals()
return ["AIRCRAFT" in wz.meta.keywords, RulesEngine.is_unit_engaged("U_SHIELD_CAPTAIN_A", s)]

var m = tree.root.get_node("Main")
var focus := Vector2(1450.0, 380.0)
var z := 1.6
var vp: Vector2 = m.get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
m.camera.position = focus
m.camera.zoom = Vector2(z, z)
m.view_zoom = z
m.view_offset = focus - vp / (2.0 * z)
m.update_view_transform()
return true

steps.comment: the drag below really goes through the Wazbom's base: the engine's own path sweep (MoveType.sweep_moves_through, base 1 mm smaller) overlaps it
23.02: the Ordered Retreat may pass the AIRCRAFT model — staged
staged where it was dropped, past the Wazbom (not clamped short of it)
an Ordered Retreat: no hazard rolls
